svg.aria-label: Pruthvi Panchal. Engineering systems where every microsecond matters. Go, distributed systems and low-latency infrastructure. Software engineer at Greeksoft Technologies, GIFT City, India. Beside the name, a dotted Earth spins with Gandhinagar lit up and the Moon in orbit.
